title: Kitchen SinkShroom Revolutionary Clog-Free Stainless Steel Sink Strainer, Chrome gray
description:
About this item
With stainless steel construction and a uniquely ergonomic design, the Kitchen SinkShroom will neatly catch food particles without stopping the flow of water
The intuitive hollow center cylinder is raised high enough to prevent pots and dishes from blocking the drain--grab it to easily remove the strainer
No matter how much refuse or food is gathered in the basket, optimal hole placement keeps water flowing--and keeps dirty dish water from rising
The patent-pending Kitchen SinkShroom is made by the creators of the award-winning TubShroom and ShowerShroom drain protectors, and the StopShroom plug
A 2019 Housewares Design Awards Finalist, our revolutionary basket fits virtually any kitchen sink drain or garbage disposal drain without any special tools
› See more product details
reviews_5s: I had some plastic strainers on my kitchen sink to prevent unintentionally allowing items from going into the drain. They occasionally would prevent the water from flowing, and it was difficult to keep them clean. These stainless steel strainers are easier to keep clean, and they rarely impede the flow of water, even while catching debris or food scraps.No more sticking hands into disgusting backed up water full of slimy food particles. Can be full of gunk and water still drains. Best $10 I’ve ever spent.Very useful. Easy to rinse out. I’m very glad I bought it. Stainless steel.Pleased to get this for my kitchen sink drain. The item is the right size for the kitchen sink and seems to trap particles of food well without constantly needing to be emptied. It also does not get covered with debris that must be scraped out. Everything about this device makes life at the kitchen sink easier and cleaner.Absolutely stopped my sink from getting clogged!! I was going to buy a garbage disposal which would cost hundreds of dollars plus an electrician to install it BUT this literally stopped all the clogging of food!!Finally a product that really does the jobI’ve been through way too many lesser strainers over the years, but those frustrating days are behind me. It’s sturdy, easy to clean, and doesn’t retain water. This strainer is a keeper.At first I thought it looked pretty weird and I couldn't figure out how it could be better than what my sink came with. It still looks weird, but it works fabulously.Bought this to replace my old sink strainer. Works great! Easy to clean! Lays nice and flat in my sink. Would buy againIt works great! Easy to empty. I highly recommend.
reviews_1s:
If you ever wonder whether to believe the reviews whether it’s real or maybe just a user error and I promise you that you are going to want to pay attention to this review. There is a plastic piece that this product comes with, and that will be the first to fail, Very FAST! Product failed in 5 months Purchased this drain in September 2024 and as of February 2025, 5 months, the drain, and the black holder at the top has completely detached and deteriorated. It is impossible to use this drainer properly without the plastic piece. I regretted reading the reviews because most of these people probably reviewed it right away after using it without seeing how it performs over time.Update: Changing from 2 stars to 1. No part of this should be made of the forever chemical plastic. Poured hot pasta water down the drain and it melted the already too short knob and bent it sideways. End of Update.
What sold me on buying this was the report that it drained even when dishes were on top of it. My old one is a cheap one found at the grocery store, that is just a sieve basket. When a plate is placed in the sink, water can not drain, unless one pushes the plate upwards. My housemates refuse to do that.
I saw this in an ad and really wanted that feature. This drainer has holes like a colander, plainly seen in the images, but I didn't think anything of it. It therefore drains much more slowly than the sieve style. The raised center isn't raised enough and my plates still block water drainage.
It looks nicer than the one I had, due to the wide, finished edge. My old one is cheap and the edge didn't get folded correctly when it was manufactured, and the wires hang out on one spot which often causes puncture wounds when emptying it out. Even with that, I'm going back to the old one, which just drains better, faster, and easier, with food particles in the way.
Redesign this one, with a sieve style and the center piece raised at least another 1/4 of an inch, and it would be perfect.The product’s main feature is that it drains better than the alternatives. However, in actual use, I found that it does not do that. It gets clogged even easier than what I had previously. What’s the point of the Shroom if it doesn’t even drain when it’s semi clogged?!Good idea but it does not retain water nor fit in my sink drain. It also does not look like the one on the package. Waste of money for my household.I have been buying this product since 2021 and I kept replacing it until I finally realized that it was NOT normal to fall apart. I have bought 9 of these things, 9. And each and every one ripped up after a short time making it completely unusable. I just thought that's how these things were supposed to be - short term. Wrong.

The rubber / plastic part in the middle traps the hair and junk and you cannot clean it out. If you try to remove the rubber / plastic part to clean it out, it's almost impossible to get back in place and most times it rips. What a mess! I resorted to buying the 2-pack so I would have something when inevitably one would rip.

Finally (what took me so long?), I decided to buy a stainless steel drainer, no plastic, no rubber, nothing to rip and I have 2 of these in my sinks and they are sturdy, holding up and doing the job. And guess what? The stainless steel ones are a FRACTION of the cost of the Sinkshoom.

Sinkshoom 2-pack $19.43. Does not work well, does not last.
Stainless steel sink strainer 2-pack $5.99. Works extremely well. Lasts and lasts.This strainer is awesome but it fails in the materials that it is made from. The column in the center of the strainer is rubber/plastic and sticks up over the bottom to the sink basin. When you put heavy items in the sink, the column gets deformed and, in my case, eventually breaks. This has rendered the sink strainer unusable. Sad because the design is wonderful.The point was to be able to press the center rubber piece down to seal the drain. The rubber is so very stiff that it cannot be pressed in. Waiting for the possibility that it might soften enough to work properly is a waste of my time and likely my money. I plan to return this item.I bought this sink strainer/food trap back in January. It is now November and the plastic insert is already broken and falling apart. Prior to this, the black insert would almost ALWAYS fall out, for what reason...I have no clue. Don't waste your money on this. When food particles get lodged in it, it clogs up the sink leaving it full of water--it doesn't work as advertised AT ALL. You're better off not wasting your money and buying a product that actually works, please steer clear of this one.Didn’t lasted even for a year.
See pictures just after 6 months it’s broken.Plastic corroded into pieces within 15 months. It just turned to pieces… some sort of acidic food? I don’t know but you can’t rely on this as a long term solution. Otherwise, it worked well before it broke. I’d say durability is very low but ten bucks a year may be cheap enough to consider repurchasing. I will shop for other options.
